name: Kontainer File Picker
author: Jesper Sandberg

sections.description:
Connect your WordPress site with Kontainer DAM and work with your digital assets directly inside the CMS.
The Kontainer File Picker plugin gives editors and marketing teams seamless access to images, videos, and documents—ensuring that all content is always up-to-date, approved, and ready to use.
No downloads. No duplicates. No outdated files.

Work directly from your DAM

With Kontainer integrated into WordPress, your entire asset library is available where you create content.

  • Browse folders and structure directly from Kontainer
  • Search using metadata, tags, and filters
  • Preview and insert assets in just a few clicks
  • Work without leaving the WordPress editor

All assets remain centrally managed in Kontainer—your single source of truth.

Video

See how Kontainer can create value for you and your business.

Always use the right content

Avoid outdated files, inconsistent naming, and brand errors.
With Kontainer DAM:

  • You always access the latest approved versions
  • Permissions and rights follow your DAM setup
  • Brand guidelines are enforced across your website

This ensures consistency, compliance, and professional content—every time.

Gain full visibility and control

Kontainer doesn’t just deliver files—it gives you insight.

  • See where assets are used across WordPress and Kontainer
  • Maintain an overview of content usage
  • Quickly update or replace files across your site

This makes it easier to manage content at scale and avoid errors.

Read more about the WordPress integration.

Optimize assets automatically

Deliver optimized assets without extra work:

  • Download templates transform images on the fly (size, format, cropping)
  • Naming templates ensure consistent filenames and support SEO
  • No need for manual editing before upload

Your website stays fast, optimized, and consistent.

Learn more about templates.

Key benefits

  • Direct DAM access inside WordPress
  • No manual downloads or uploads
  • Always use approved and up-to-date assets
  • Search and filter via metadata
  • Full visibility into asset usage
  • Built-in SEO and image optimization
  • Reduced media library clutter
  • Built for modern content teams

By connecting your DAM to WordPress, you ensure:

  • Faster content production
  • Fewer errors
  • Stronger brand consistency

Why use Kontainer with WordPress?

Without a DAM, media management in WordPress quickly becomes fragmented and difficult to control.

With Kontainer:

  • Your assets stay centralized
  • Your workflows become more efficient
  • Your content stays consistent and compliant

The result: better websites, better workflows, and better control.
sections.installation: After installing the plugin, go to Settings and set the Kontainer URL.
